title: Marquette Law School national poll, next wave: forward seal of the trust item
made_at_note: predictions.json was written at this time (file mtime, UTC)
sealed_at_note: written by our own machine; the independent date is the OpenTimestamps proof marquette-national-2026-11-seal.json.ots
code_note: the commit of the private code repository that made the predictions; it cannot be checked from outside

method.history: GSS 2000-2024 (13 waves), TRUST; GSS 2024 was released 2025-05-22
method.offset: forecast = engine two-way share + the mean, over every Marquette national wave since Sept 2021, of Marquette's published total minus the engine's two-way total from the GSS history current at that wave; one offset for every cell
method.bands: empirical: the 80th and 95th percentiles of this method's out-of-time misses on the same cell, Marquette 2021-2026 (backtest.json), centred on the forecast

study.name: Marquette Law School Poll, national adults, next wave after Sept 2-9 2026
study.expected_fieldwork: ASSUMPTION: early to mid November 2026, inferred from the 2022-2025 cadence (2025: Nov 5-12; 2022: Nov 15-22); not announced

item.wording: Generally speaking, would you say that most people can be trusted, or most people can't be trusted?
item.history: asked on every national wave since Sept 2021 (32 waves, 44-57%)

study.items_assumption: ASSUMPTION: the next wave asks the item with the Sept 2026 wording and options
study.cells_note: Crosstab groups: Male, Female; age 18-29; Less than HS = no_hs, HS graduate = hs, Vocational/tech school/some college/associates = some_college, Bachelor's degree = college, Post grad study/professional degree = postgrad; White Non-Hispanic, Black Non-Hispanic, Hispanic, Other. Age 30-44, 45-59 and 60+ split or merge the frame's decade bands and are not predicted. Marquette publishes no region.
study.weighting_note: Marquette weights on, among others, civic engagement, party ID, registration and religious affiliation (SSRS methods report); not on trust

predictions_json.hash_recipe: sha256 over the file's bytes exactly as written by `prior-backtest extend --predict-only` (json.dumps(content, indent=2) followed by one newline)

content.study: Marquette Law School Poll, national adults (predictions)
content.frame_dates_note: frame:2023 is seeded from acs_pums 2023, published 2024-10-17 (ACS 2023 data release schedule, '1-Year Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) Files'; fielded continuously across calendar year 2023); the study's fieldwork began 2026-11-02, as supplied

history.note: GSS 2000-2016 (9 waves) have no recorded release date and count as released because GSS 2024, released 2025-05-22, came after them

content.ledger: these predictions are not recorded in the prediction ledger and carry no ledger id; this report and its JSON file are the record

history_input.how_read: Totals: the trend-topline table on https://law.marquette.edu/assets/community/poll/MLSPSC35/MLSPSC35TrendToplines.html (whole percentages and unweighted n per wave). Cells: the crosstab row percentages (whole numbers) and group n of each wave's public crosstab page (crosstab_url), read as published; only the groups that are frame cuts are kept (sex, age 18-29, the five education groups, the four race and ethnicity groups). Wave numbers follow the MLSPSC numbering of the asset paths.

scoring_plan: Target: the first Marquette Law School Poll national adult wave released after this seal's OpenTimestamps attestation, adult sample, the item quoted in study.item.
Not scored, with the reason, if Marquette drops the item, changes its wording or answer options, or released that wave before the attestation.

Total: the trend-topline percentage 'Most people can be trusted' (whole number). Cells: the crosstab row percentage of each of the 12 groups in study.cells (whole numbers), groups mapped as in study.cells_note. A cell the crosstab does not publish is not scored.

Metric: absolute miss in points per cell, for the forecast and for both sealed baselines; headline = the mean over the 12 cells, the total reported beside it. Marquette's integers carry about half a point of rounding.
Bands: whether each published share falls inside the sealed 80% and 95% bands.
Claim: 'sealed before fieldwork' only if the wave's published fieldwork start is later than the attestation's block time; otherwise 'sealed before publication'.
